- `pointer-only-subagent-briefs` (reconsider): variant via `self-contained-subagent-brief`; reject; reason: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3: rejected. Opposite stance: a brief carries the role contract, outcome and goal, owned paths, constraints, acceptance checks and report format beside its context pointers, and copies in any reference material the worker needs but cannot otherwise reach (self-contained-subagent-brief, the variant delegation holds); a planless brief names the relevant source sections, invariants and checks. Pointers alone would drop that contract (.claude/skills/delegation/SKILL.md:43-47; AGENTS.md:49-50; .claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/implement/task-engine.md:42-44).
